scope: The excavated Roman amphitheatre at Mérida, including the surviving lower stone terraces, longitudinal vaulted approaches, retaining podium and exposed central arena pit.

originalReview.notes: Exact arena photograph records the exposed pit, fragmentary stone steps, continuous low retaining podium, and taller axial and smaller side vaults.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla photograph is the author’s own public-domain release and shows the amphitheatre. The other two public-domain candidate images show the separate Roman circus and were excluded.
